{"content": "1|def transform(grid):
2|    """Replicate the marker's asymmetric pattern at every all-zero matching location."""
3|    source = [row[:] for row in grid]
4|    colors = {v for row in source for v in row if v not in (0, 1, 5)}
5|    if not colors:
6|        return source
7|    marker = min(colors)
8|    pts = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(source) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == marker]
9|    r0, c0 = min(r for r, c in pts), min(c for r, c in pts)
10|    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in pts]
11|    h, w = len(source), len(source[0])
12|    matches = []
13|    for r in range(h):
14|        for c in range(w):
15|            cells = [(r+dr, c+dc) for dr, dc in shape]
16|            if all(0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and source[rr][cc] == 0 for rr, cc in cells):
17|                matches.extend(cells)
18|    result = [row[:] for row in source]
19|    for r, c in matches:
20|        result[r][c] = marker
21|    return result
